effects: The signer sends msg.value CORE (native) to the CoreAgent contract. It must be at least requiredCoinDeposit (1 CORE at init) or the call reverts.
The signer's stake on `candidate` and their total delegated amount both grow by msg.value. The candidate is added to the signer's delegation list if it was not there.
Rewards the signer earned on this candidate in earlier rounds are moved into rewardMap, to be claimed later. Nothing is paid out in this call.
formats.shown: "Delegate CORE", with the validator address and the CORE amount taken from the transaction value.

findings.title: delegateCoin has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line leaves out the amount and the validator.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json delegateCoin: "intent": "Delegate CORE" and no interpolatedIntent. Both values appear only as fields (`@.value` 'CORE amount', `candidate` 'Validator Address').

findings.title: delegateCoin's minimum stake of requiredCoinDeposit comes from storage and is not shown.
findings.evidence: CoreAgent.sol delegateCoin: require(msg.value >= requiredCoinDeposit, "delegate amount is too small"). The value is a governance parameter in storage.
findings.fix: None needed. A smaller amount only makes the call revert.

effects: The signer's stake on `candidate` and their total delegated amount both fall by `amount`. If this empties the position and nothing was transferred, the delegation record is removed.
`amount` CORE (native) is sent from the contract back to the signer (msg.sender).
An amount of 0 reverts ('Undelegate zero coin'). A partial amount must be at least requiredCoinDeposit and must leave at least requiredCoinDeposit staked.
Rewards from earlier rounds on this candidate are moved into rewardMap, to be claimed later. Transferred-amount bookkeeping is reduced across the signer's other candidates.
formats.shown: "Unstake CORE", with the validator address and the amount, labelled 'CORE amount (0=All)'.

findings.title: undelegateCoin's label says 0 unstakes everything, but a direct call with 0 reverts.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json undelegateCoin field `amount` label "CORE amount (0=All)". CoreAgent.sol undelegateCoin calls _undelegateCoin(candidate, msg.sender, amount, false), which starts with require(amount != 0, 'Undelegate zero coin'). Only proxyUnDelegate (onlyPledgeAgent) turns 0 into the full balance. Following the label gives a failed transaction, not a full unstake. Per not_critical #10 this is a wording issue: the outcome is not different, so it is a warning.
findings.fix: Change the label to "CORE amount" (or "CORE to unstake") and drop "(0=All)".

findings.title: undelegateCoin's intent does not say the CORE comes back to the signer or how much.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json undelegateCoin: "intent": "Unstake CORE" and no interpolatedIntent. CoreAgent.sol: Address.sendValue(payable(msg.sender), amount).

formats.key: transferCoin(address sourceCandidate, address targetCandidate, uint256 amount)
effects: The signer's stake on `sourceCandidate` falls by `amount`, and the moved part is recorded as transferredAmount so it still earns this round's reward.
The signer's stake on `targetCandidate` grows by `amount`. No CORE enters or leaves the wallet.
It reverts if the target cannot accept delegations, if source equals target, if amount is 0, or if the partial-amount minimums are not met.
Rewards from earlier rounds on both candidates are moved into rewardMap, to be claimed later.
formats.shown: "Move staked CORE", with the From validator, the To validator and the amount in CORE.

findings.title: transferCoin has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line leaves out the amount and both validators.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json transferCoin: "intent": "Move staked CORE" and no interpolatedIntent. The values appear only as the fields sourceCandidate, targetCandidate and amount.
